limitations: The test used the declared 2.5 kN radial load, 1,500 rpm, and maximum 60 C ambient condition but observed only 800 hours rather than 10,000 hours.
Only three organization-selected prototypes were tested.
Raw observations, the extrapolation model, and censoring and failure treatment were not published.
No failures during 800 hours does not by itself establish an expected operating life of at least 10,000 hours.
The report covers dimensional conformity and material composition only.
It explicitly does not test operating life, durability, fatigue, or performance under the declared operating conditions.
The tested sample was supplied and selected by the organization under a paid-testing relationship.
Issuer authenticity and artifact integrity do not expand the report scope.

missing_support: Published raw time-to-event observations for the tested bearings.
A disclosed and justified statistical or engineering extrapolation from 800 observed hours to at least 10,000 expected hours, including censoring and failure treatment.
Evidence that tested samples are representative of production units and linked to identified production batches.
Independent or randomly sampled lifetime evidence under the full declared operating conditions.
risk_gaps: The claimed lifetime is 12.5 times the published observation window.
The small, organization-selected prototype sample creates selection and representativeness risk.
The absence of raw observations and an extrapolation model prevents reproduction or validation of the lifetime inference.
No S3 random purchase or random sampling evidence is present.
The third-party report is authentic-looking but out of scope for the lifetime claim.

next_checks.action: Request the existing raw observations, complete test protocol, censoring and failure definitions, and the exact extrapolation model and calculations used to infer at least 10,000 hours from the 800-hour test.
next_checks.reason: These existing materials are the lowest-cost way to determine whether the central lifetime inference is reproducible and technically justified.

next_checks.action: Request serial numbers, build records, production status, and batch linkage for all three prototypes, plus evidence that their design and manufacturing process match saleable NMC-NA4908 units.
next_checks.reason: This checks whether the observed prototypes can reasonably support a claim about the published product model.

next_checks.action: Obtain independent testing on randomly selected production units or market-purchased NMC-NA4908 bearings under the complete declared conditions.
next_checks.reason: Independent random sampling would reduce hand-picked-sample and first-party measurement risks.

next_checks.action: If the existing data and model do not adequately justify the extrapolation, conduct a suitably powered life test or validated accelerated-life program covering the declared load, speed, and temperature, with predefined endpoints and statistical analysis.
next_checks.reason: Direct or validly accelerated lifetime evidence is needed if the short prototype run cannot support the 10,000-hour expectation.

summary: The package verifies identity continuity and package integrity, but the published evidence is insufficient to support the 10,000-hour expected-life claim. The only lifetime-relevant evidence is a first-party 800-hour test of three organization-selected prototypes with no failures, no raw observations, and no disclosed extrapolation model. The third-party report verifies only dimensions and material composition and explicitly does not assess lifetime or the declared operating conditions. Claim truth therefore remains not determined, and fraud is not established.
